Pushed successfully to branch `bb/relay-152-notifications-v1-05-05-broadcast-live-thr_udspe3kspi`.

## Summary

Implements issue #152 (notifications-v1 05/05): broadcasting live notifications and synchronizing read state across sessions.

**Data layer (`@semprec/data`):**
- `notificationsStore.ts`: `listUnreadNotificationsForUser` (deterministic unread recovery for reconnecting clients), `visitNotification` (ownership-scoped, atomic, idempotent visit-and-read), `markAllNotificationsRead`.
- `realtimeHook.ts`: new `notifyNotificationCreated`/`notifyNotificationReadState` hooks, following the existing invalidation/doc-update hook pattern.
- `notify.ts`: `writeNotification` now fires `notifyNotificationCreated` (deferred via `runAfterCommit`) exactly once per genuinely new notification — never on a replayed transition or a rolled-back transaction.

**Realtime layer (`@semprec/realtime`):**
- New `notification_created`/`notification_read_state` message kinds, both carrying `userId`.
- `startRealtimeServer` now accepts an optional `resolveUserId` adapter; any message with a `userId` is delivered only to that user's own sockets, while existing broadcast traffic (`item_invalidation`, `doc_update`) is unaffected — kept as a separable adapter per the issue's note about later absorption into the full multiplexed WS protocol.

**API layer (`semprec-api`):**
- New `GET /api/notifications/unread`, `POST /api/notifications/:id/visit`, `POST /api/notifications/mark-all-read`, all authenticated and scoped to the caller's own notifications, wired into `app.ts` and documented in `routeMatrix.ts`.

Note: this branch also merges in `develop`'s notifications-v1 01–04 work (schema, writer, push registrations, Web Push/APNs), since that foundation had landed upstream after this branch was originally cut but before this issue could build on it.

**Verification:** full build, lint, format check, and test suite (unit + integration + e2e, 875+ tests) all pass.
